correctness.rationale: Conditioning on both extreme observations, the k=n-2 internal draws are a uniform k-subset of {1,...,r-1}, independent of location a and ambient population M. Their exact first and second power sums and finite-population variance yield E T=nr/2, E T^2=n^2r^2/4+(n-2)r(r-n+1)/12 and E Q=r^2+(n-2)r(2r-1)/6. E[(Q-T^2/n)/(n-1)] is exactly r(n+1)((n+2)r-(n-2))/(12n(n-1)) for all n-1<=r<=M, 2<=n<=M+1; n=2 reduces r^2/2 and the full-interior-sampling boundary remains valid. An arithmetic progression multiplies by its lattice spacing squared. Independent rational exhaustive range strata over all populations M=2..13 confirmed 454 strata from 32,646 subsets; not used as an infinite proof.
